label: Evolution-11's best sparring against evolution-1
description: Starts from evolution-11's best net (gen 27, copied) and plays half its games against evolution-1's best (gen 432), to see whether it can learn to beat it. Same settings as evolution-11 (512 / 256 net, plain and smart phases) plus the sparring partner. The dashboard's partner tile shows its win rate against evolution-1.
